key_inputs.target_chip: MIFARE Ultralight MF0ICU1 (NXP), 64 bytes, 16 pages x 4 bytes
key_inputs.motivating_question: Determine what is stored on a hotel key card and why NXP TagInfo / NFC Tools refuse to dump or format it

user_decisions.gradle_structure: single :app module with strict package boundaries
user_decisions.write_safety: guarded writes; lock-byte and OTP writes gated behind expert mode

device.adb_status_at_plan_time: detected once, then dropped off - reconfirm before Phase 0 Task 0.3

assumptions_and_constraints: MF0ICU1 has no GET_VERSION, FAST_READ, PWD_AUTH, or dynamic lock bits - dynamic lock decode is deferred to Phase 2 with NTAG21x and reported as unsupported-by-chip in Phase 1
MifareUltralight.readPages returns 16 bytes and wraps past the last page - the reader must discard the wrapped tail or page indices will be silently wrong
NFC hardware does not exist in the Android emulator, so all tag I/O sits behind UltralightTransport and is proven on the JVM via a fake that emulates MF0ICU1 semantics
domain package must contain zero android.* imports, enforced by DomainPurityTest rather than convention
Writes to page 0x02 (lock bytes) and 0x03 (OTP) are irreversible in hardware and are expert-mode gated; pages 0-1 are never writable
Compose screens and Hilt modules are exempted from the per-file unit test rule with a stated reason; ViewModels are not exempt
AGP/Kotlin/Compose version pins are validated by a real assembleDebug in Phase 0 rather than trusted from memory
save_point_commit_policy: One focused commit per task where a commit is named; git init happens in Task 0.2 since the directory is not yet a repository. Behaviour-changing slices commit only after their GREEN validation command passes.

waves.write_scope: disjoint files under domain/decoder, domain/writer and their tests
disjoint packages ui/taginfo, ui/memory, ui/locks, ui/log

phases.title: Toolchain proven
phases.outcome: empty Compose app builds, installs and launches on the Pixel 10; version pins validated by real resolution

phases.title: Domain model and pure decoders
phases.outcome: every MF0ICU1 decode rule implemented and proven on the JVM with zero hardware

phases.title: Android NFC transport and read pipeline
phases.outcome: a real tap produces a correct, wrap-aware 16-page dump with per-page status

phases.title: UI
phases.outcome: all four destinations render real session data in dark and light M3

phases.title: Guarded write
phases.outcome: a page can be written behind arm-and-confirm; every refusal and exception explained

phases.title: Export
phases.outcome: a session leaves the device as valid JSON and readable TXT via SAF

phases.title: Verification and closeout
phases.outcome: AC1-AC8 evidenced, JVM and device evidence separated, README written
